d: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a “tremendous tax” on American companies that build AI data centres outside the United States, raising questions about the future of overseas technology investments. Trump argued that the US must maintain its lead over China in artificial intelligence and keep critical computing infrastructure at home. However, he did not specify the proposed tax rate, the companies it would affect or when the measure could take effect. The warning could have implications for India, which is rapidly expanding its data centre industry.
